goal: Ship the ai-daytrader learning system (Waves 2-9 + research ingestion) as independently-claimable module tickets for cheap executor models. Specs: PLAYBOOK.md + PROCESS_IMPROVEMENTS.md; interfaces: ARCHITECTURE.md section 4-6.

modules.title: PIT layer: bar loader, broker core, model registry (A1, A2, A5)
acceptance: load_bars serves only ts/open/high/low/close/volume from data/historical/ (causal-column guard)
get_bars visibility exactly bar_end <= as_of (off-by-one test green)
short-history assets (BONK) return partial lookback without raising
model registry returns newest training_end < as_of, raises ModelNotAvailable otherwise

modules.title: Event store + derived-event ingestion (A3, A4)
acceptance: query filters on available_at <= as_of, never published_at
fear/greed zone crossings and funding extremes emit events using only strictly-prior data for percentiles
data/events.parquet built by script with count-by-type summary

modules.title: Package blinding for LLM review (A7)
acceptance: blind=True renders relative labels only; regex finds no absolute dates or month names

modules.title: Leakage corruption test, positive + negative control (A6)
acceptance: corrupting all future bars leaves past decisions byte-identical
intentionally broken visibility filter makes the negative-control test fail as designed

modules.title: PIT-fed backtest driver + dual-fee scorecards (A8)
acceptance: GameRunner receives prices only via PITBroker (spy-asserted)
runs both fee profiles (realistic 0.25%, stress 0.6%) and writes runs/<run_id>/ artifacts
baseline champion (top_tier_baseline) completes a 90-day window

modules.title: Ledger schema + repos with micro-loop states, prompts, provenance (B1-B3)

illegal lifecycle transitions raise; every transition requires a reason
failed_block renders negative-knowledge markdown; provenance report renders per-proposer table

modules.title: Operator intake CLI: hypothesize + event add (B4)
acceptance: hypothesize files a ledger row at PROPOSED with manual_priority=1 and prints the id
event add ingests via EventStore with sentiment mapping and default latency
bad input exits non-zero with a clear message

modules.title: Weekly review, epoch post-mortem, health report + trials panel (C1-C3)

post_mortem files each research_request as a PROPOSED hypothesis
health report renders lifecycle counts, trials panel (N tested all-time, expected false discoveries), champion-vs-challenger, LLM budget usage

modules.title: GATE 1 run: infrastructure honest-loop (PLAYBOOK section 5.1)
acceptance: full suite green; leakage positive + negative controls behave as designed
90-day dual-fee backtest completes with >=12 journaled weekly reviews (replay mode allowed)
health report renders all sections; blinded packages contain no absolute dates
verifier is a different session/model than the implementers (maker != checker)

modules.title: Causal derived features + news features (D1s, D2s / TASKS W6-1, W6-2)
acceptance: rel_strength, universe_corr_state, time_features, news features wired into build_frame
every feature is causal: corrupting future rows leaves past values unchanged

modules.title: Rule-based PIT-safe regime provider (D3s / W5-0)
acceptance: detect_regime returns state/vol_level/trend/vol from visible bars only
regime_series is row-causal (future corruption changes nothing in the past)

modules.title: Signal registry: seed causal signals + dynamic registration (D4s / W6-0)
acceptance: seed signals (rsi_14, macd_hist, bb_pct_20, ret_24h, vol_24h, funding_z_30d, fg_zone) hand-checked on fixtures
causality test passes for every registered signal including a dynamic one
dynamic signals re-register from ledger params at startup (no pickled closures)

modules.title: Pattern scout: sweeps, filters, lens, assembly-as-filer (E1-E4)
acceptance: planted lead-lag and conditional effects are found; noise yields only p>0.05 candidates
Bonferroni + orthogonality filters exercised individually with reconciling stats
lens judges ONE candidate per LLM call with the negative-knowledge block; plausibility none sets oos_multiplier
scout only FILES candidates at PROPOSED with discovery_window recorded; it decides nothing

modules.title: Signal Lab micro-loop: pump, ablation + permutation control, lifecycle + shadow (W6L-0/1/2)
acceptance: pump advances each non-terminal hypothesis exactly one gated transition, idempotent and crash-safe
ablation validates on a window disjoint from discovery with horizon embargo, realistic fees, per-regime split
permutation control (200 shuffles) rejects a planted market-drift edge
shadow stage gates live promotion; decay/retire/recover transitions all ledgered with reasons

modules.title: GATE 2 run: autonomous discovery end-to-end (PLAYBOOK section 5.2 + PROCESS_IMPROVEMENTS section 6)
acceptance: 90-day replay: scout averages >=5 lensed candidates/week; >=10 signals reach validated; >=1 live and >=1 rejected with reason
re-run proposes ZERO previously-rejected theses (negative knowledge holds)
acceptance rate reported within 20-60 percent band or investigated
a degraded shadow signal is demonstrably NOT promoted

modules.title: Strategy forge: spec, population assembly, hardened promotion (G1-G3)
acceptance: StrategySpec schema-validated; unknown signal names rejected; to_policy adapts to v1_game Policy honoring decaying weight_multiplier
population = k LLM specs + m jittered + champion; invalid LLM specs ledgered as rejects
promotion requires 2 consecutive epoch wins on all gates, >=20 round-trips/epoch, wins under BOTH fee profiles; row stores both scorecards

modules.title: Risk layer: effective bets, kill-switch ladder, notifications (H1-H3)
acceptance: correlated-cluster effective bets math verified on hand fixtures; enforcement scales down never up
kill-switch rungs trigger and clear per spec with precedence HALT > FLAT > FLOOR
non-NONE actions notify once per action per day

modules.title: Rhythm daemon + data quality + LLM budgets (I1-I3)
acceptance: simulated 10-day clock fires hourly/daily/weekly/epoch jobs the right number of times; restart mid-week never double-fires (state from ledger only)
daily job = decay check + feed quality feeding KillSwitch; weekly job = review + scout filing + pump
budgets block optional jobs and queue mandatory ones

modules.title: GATE 3 run: full autonomous 90-day rhythm (PLAYBOOK section 5.3)
acceptance: orchestrated 90-day run: all cadences fire correctly with ledger evidence; >=3 epochs with populations, scorecards, post-mortems
promotion machinery demonstrated (real or forced-fixture) and every epoch's decision ledgered
kill-switch fire drill halts and notifies once; restart mid-run double-fires nothing
realistic-fee scorecard beats 5-asset equal-weight baseline OR post-mortems explain why with filed directives

modules.title: PIT research store: documents/scores/entities/edges/rollups schema + repos (WR-0)
acceptance: three-timestamp model (published_at/observed_at/available_at) with backfilled flag; replay query docs_asof excludes future available_at
append-only: edits chain via supersedes; dedup by (source, source_uid, body_sha)
a backfilled insert cannot alter narrative rollups for hours before its own available_at
graph_asof(T) serves only edges with first_learned_at <= T

modules.title: Collectors, all LLM-free: Reddit, YouTube, RSS/PR-wires, GDELT, attention, DefiLlama (WR-1/2/5/6/8/9) — start early, corpus accrues
acceptance: every API verified via /pre-code BEFORE coding; unverifiable -> BLOCKED, not written from memory
collectors write documents to the research store with correct available_at semantics and zero LLM calls; collector_runs row per run
RSS collector is one generic parser driven by config/research_sources.yaml (crypto media + PR wires + exchange announcements)
Google Trends stored as dated snapshots (forward-only); Wikipedia pageviews backfillable as GOLD
normalizers fixture-tested; failures degrade per-source, never crash the run

modules.title: EDGAR collector: 8-K + Form 4 for crypto-adjacent tickers, 10-K supplier/customer text (WR-7)

SEC fair-access rules respected (User-Agent, rate limits)

modules.title: Doc scorer: one doc per classifier call, mechanics-not-outcomes, scored once (WR-10)
acceptance: one document per LLM call; schema-validated sentiment/magnitude/novelty/themes/entities/claims
prompts blinded of absolute dates; claims are mechanics not outcomes (model-knowledge leakage guard)
scores written once with model_id; re-scores append versioned, never overwrite

modules.title: Theme graph builder: LLM edge extraction + EDGAR edges + GDELT co-mentions, PIT edges (WR-11)
acceptance: edges carry relation type, confidence, provenance doc, first_learned_at = teaching doc's available_at
graph_asof(T) returns only edges learned before T (knowledge-lookahead guard, test-proven)

modules.title: Narrative rollups + burst detector + broker frame features via feature_fns seam (WR-12)

frame gains news_burst/sent_wmean_24h/novelty_max_24h/attention_z via the broker feature_fns seam (no broker.py edits)

modules.title: Theme-propagation scout sweep: shock -> graph walk -> hypothesis filing (WR-13)
acceptance: narrative/price shock at a graph entity proposes hypotheses for 1- and 2-hop tradeable neighbors with edge-chain provenance and direction
proposals enter the standard micro-loop at PROPOSED (no special trust; ablation + permutation still gate them)
walk uses graph_asof(T) — a chain learned after T cannot generate hypotheses at T (test-proven)

modules.title: Backfill harness: GDELT/Wikipedia/DefiLlama/EDGAR/HN historical loads, silver-tier discipline (WR-14)

modules.title: Thesis extractor + per-source scoreboard (WR-3, WR-4)
acceptance: one item -> one classifier-role call -> structured thesis or logged SKIP; testable theses filed at PROPOSED with manual_priority=2
scoreboard reports per source: filed / survived-screen / accepted / reached-live with rates, split by gold vs silver (backfilled) evidence

modules.title: Event-study sweep: asset reaction patterns after macro/company events (W5-5, audit gap G1)
